lines: I appreciate you taking me out here...
But you know I can swim, right?
Not sure I'd call that swimming...

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hey! I was able to catch you!

lines: And I'll never live it down.
Why'd you wanna go on a boat, though?

choices.text: It's an excuse to spend some time alone with you.
What, are you scared of a little boat?
We can go back if you don't want to.

lines: You could've just said that.
Alright, move over.
Scared? Seriously?
I could swim circles around this thing.
I didn't say that.
C'mon, let's go already.
Huh.
It's actually pretty nice out here.
Still feels weird being above the water instead of in it.
You ever go swimming out this far?

choices.text: Maybe you could take me sometime.
Do you miss being a fish?

lines: You sure you could keep up with me?
...I might take you up on that.
Don't tempt me.
I'd win, obviously.
Sometimes.
But I guess being up here has its perks.
You know...
I really wasn't planning on sticking around.
Didn't think there'd be much worth staying for.
But I guess things turned out alright.

choices.text: Maybe you just couldn't stay away from me.
I'm glad you decided to stay.

lines: Don't flatter yourself.
...But you're not completely wrong.
And leave you alone with your terrible steering?
Yeah, no thanks.
...Yeah.
Me too.
Looks like we're getting pretty far from shore.
Guess we should head back soon.
Unless you've got another reason to keep me out here.

choices.text: Maybe I just don't want our date to end yet.
Actually, I was planning to leave you stranded.
We can head back whenever you're ready.

lines: Getting a little attached, are we?
...Can't say I blame you.
Oh, real funny.
Just remember I'm the one who can swim back.
Nah. We can stay a little longer.
I'm not in a rush.
Hey.
Don't go making a big deal out of this, but...
I had fun.
If you wanna do this again sometime...
I guess I wouldn't mind.
